_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values for local development.
TWO BUILD MODES — set PUBLIC_MODE to choose:
- PUDO_API_KEY is baked into the app.
- FIREBASE.databaseId is NOT needed (uses the default Firestore database).
- PUDO_API_KEY should be empty; users supply their own key via their profile.
- Subscription is validated on every login via Firestore.
- FIREBASE.databaseId is required if the project uses a named Firestore
database (e.g. 'pudo-booking-pub' instead of the default database).
In CI/CD the correct values are injected automatically from GitHub Secrets:
See .github/workflows/build-mac.yml for the full secret reference.

FIREBASE._comment_internal: Use these fields for PUBLIC_MODE=false (internal project)
FIREBASE._databaseId_note: databaseId — named Firestore database (e.g. 'pudo-booking-pub'). Omit for the default database.
